verdict.rationale: Wise documents exporting account statements in multiple open formats (JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), which supports partial data portability, but there's no evidence of exporting other business data (transaction history beyond statements, contacts, cards, disputes, etc.) or any documented account-closure/data-takeout process. Missing for 10: full-account data export beyond statements, explicit account closure/migration workflow, and independent confirmation of usability of these exports.
